verified_a9_facts.vital_spark: 3 at A9; each played Tainted Skill applies 3 Tainted to the player
verified_a9_facts.tainted: Adds its amount to every powered attack hit targeting the player, then clears after the enemy turn

decision_policy: After every Skill, re-observe the intent; never reuse the pre-card number.
On Whirlwind, one Tainted Skill raises the three-hit total by 9 and two raise it by 18 before Block.
Compare a defensive Skill's Block against the extra incoming damage it creates; a nominal Defend can be net-negative.
Pulsate increases Vital Spark, so refresh all Tainted assumptions after it resolves.
matchups.basis: Local v0.107.1 InfestedPrism, VitalSparkPower, and TaintedPower source; not a forum opinion.

decision_policy: Treat early HP as already scarce at high ascension; speculative scaling must still pass the next two-fight test.
Prioritize at least one reliable AoE answer and one efficient defensive answer before narrow engine pieces.
Do not force a named archetype when the offered cards solve current checks better.
